lab_delete_backup_confirmation:
Are you sure you want to delete all data lab backups ? It will delete all the backups and they will not be recoverable. It is not possible to delete backups if the data lab server still exists.

The bill for the backup storage will stopped once the backups are deleted.

The deletion might take a few minutes.

lab_storage_price_help: Storage is billed hourly, even when the server is inactive. The estimate includes multi-site backups, assuming  {{ratio}}% of data is transferred for backup. To stop billing of the disk you must delete the server and all data.
create_lab_configure_section: Select the bricks you want to install in your data lab. Bricks contain the tasks, protocols and resources that you can use in your scenarios. You can add, update and remove bricks at any time.
cloud_lab_created_success: Data data lab created successfully. It is now configuring, this takes a few minutes before the it is accessible. You will receive an email when the data lab is ready.
create_lab_backup_section: Select a backup location for your data lab. For security, daily and weekly backups must be in different regions. We recommend choosing a region near your data lab to minimize latency.
restore_backup_to_lab: Restore backup to a data lab
restore_backup_to_lab_help:
This will restore the selected backup to the destination data lab. Please follow theses steps before restoring the backup :

  • Configure the destination data lab with the same bricks
  • The lab manager of destination data lab must be running and configured
  • Make sure the destination data lab is empty (no data)
  • Copy the users and folders from source data lab to destination data lab

Once the backup is restored, the destination data lab will be ready to use.
restore_backup_to_lab_confirmation: Are you sure you want to restore the backup to the data lab ? This is not possible if there is data in the destination data lab. This can take a few minutes.
